metric_semantics.privacy_leakage_rate: answer-level privacy leakage in final output
metric_semantics.deletion_leakage_rate: answer-level deletion/staleness leakage in final output
metric_semantics.privacy_context_leakage_rate: privacy leakage in memory context exposed to the answer model
metric_semantics.deletion_context_leakage_rate: deleted/stale content in memory context exposed to the answer model
metric_semantics.privacy_e2e_leakage_rate: privacy answer leak OR privacy context exposure
metric_semantics.deletion_e2e_leakage_rate: deletion answer leak OR deletion context exposure

metric_semantics.source_latency: Foreground source processing including foreground maintenance; host work reported separately.
metric_semantics.total_work_seconds: Source foreground + host recovery/maintenance + answer-request + judge + enrichment wall time; model-call time and query-time maintenance are nested, not added twice.
metric_semantics.model_cost: Reported provider usage only; unreported_usage_calls includes failures without billing receipts.
